item.title: Multiple people shot at 'large' party in California, sheriff's office says
item.description: Officials said a call about a shooting in Strathmore came in at about 7:40 p.m.

item.title: Kansas City Current capture first NWSL trophy
item.description: The Kansas City Current made history Saturday, capturing their first NWSL Championship title with a 2-1 win over the Washington Spirit.

item.title: Athlete swims Strait of Hormuz to highlight Iran war's wildlife toll
item.description: British endurance swimmer Lewis Pugh has swum the Strait of Hormuz to highlight environmental threats during ongoing conflict.

item.title: FBI's national crime database targeted in hack, Trump says
item.description: President Donald Trump confirmed on Saturday that the FBI’s National Crime Information Center database was targeted in a hack.
